div.head: III As Epilog
div.ab: Precamur, domine, misericordiam tuam, si in hoc scripto alterutrum sit uel nimis uel minus, ut hoc emendari iubeas secundum (iuxta) uelle tuum. Et nos deuote parati sumus ad omnia que nobis precipere uelis, que unquam aliquatenus implere ualeamus.

Precamur, Domine, misericordiam tuam, si in hoc scripto alterutrum sit, vel nimis vel minus, ut hoc emendari iubeas secundum velle tuum. Et nos devote parati sumus ad omnia quæ nobis præcipere velis, quæ unquam aliquatenus implere valeamus.

And we beseech your clemency, lord! if this document contains either too much or too little, to command alterations to to be made according to your wishes. And we are zealously prepared to carry out everything you are willing to order us, in so far as it lies within our power to do so.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann.
